I play on an official server, so jerky can be a hassle to make. Here we came up with the solution to our jerky trouble. It built on ceilings supported by pillars with a 1 high wall around a 5x3 area. On top of that wall we placed more ceilings to encase the preserving bins so that we cannot fall next to them. This allowed us to double our jerky capacity while greatly reducing the area it took up. We placed ramps to get up to the height needed to use the bins as a floor, adding 3 industrial grills below the ramp for easy unloading of the farming dino. The fridges store all the meat, jerky or just cooked, while the bins store oil and spark powder. We can produce 50 jerky every 32 minutes.
